documentation.cara_kerja: Multi-stage pipeline: (1) Fetch real-time prices + fundamentals, (2) Calculate portfolio drift dari target allocation, (3) Optimize rebalancing trades dengan tax-loss harvesting, (4) Generate execution plan dengan risk limits.
documentation.fungsi: Otomatisasi rebalancing portofolio berdasarkan strategi Modern Portfolio Theory (MPT) dengan constraint management (max position size, sector limits, tax implications).
documentation.tujuan: Menghilangkan emotional bias dalam rebalancing dan memastikan portofolio selalu aligned dengan target risk profile.
